title: [Lean] Certify the complete historical PR926 Boolean D word
body:
This adds a complete, source-bound Lean certificate for the historical PR926 Boolean D word relative to its exact PR915 parent. The final theorem holds for arbitrary states on all 661 registers and restores every off-target register. All 111 target-row equations are supplied and joined; there is no missing-row or clean-state premise.

The data is pinned to PR926 0f216a345c37bc71cc0e22030ef11ec31b26a69e and PR915 e9daefe320a0043000bd9746664ed02c3287d056. The proof preserves ordered donor multiplicity and covers all 192 helper preparation entries, 306 target preparation entries and 111 injection rows. These are word-entry counts, not elementary ADD counts.

The package reuses the unchanged PR590 ordered interpreter and PR597 reversal laws. Anthony (@anthonylei)'s PR774 already proves generic XOR-linearity and compensation for a separate unary interpreter; this contribution supplies the complete actual finite PR926/915 instance in the ordered interpreter. Gareth Davidson / bitplane's finite construction and source data remain explicitly credited.

At author-checked pinned main 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea, the current selected conditional record is kappa=836330098538459/500000000000000000=0.001672660197076918, certificate 1122cb3a575f8c788345fc1bf4c108ac7c3250fb81a5988671f5eb04b3ab3045. This historical proof does not change kappa or adopt PR926 into the current selected construction. Physical/frame realization, integer lifting, precision and rounded inverse cancellation, cost, and the full multiplication theorem remain separate.

All 111 row roots and the final join have independent acceptance. The final source 3931c087 and object 31cb711a produce exactly two public axiom records, each [propext, Quot.sound], with no diagnostics. The final compiler took 1.463697 seconds; the successful row compilers took 589.820443 seconds in total. Original failures and proof repairs are preserved in the owner evidence. The package contains 127 byte-identical accepted Lean sources, core-only, plus compact source/object and terminal records. Its standalone reproduction script is supplied for CI; packaging itself has not been rebuilt and no fresh CI or repository-wide result is claimed.
